name: QuotationsTemplate
description: Template Quotation generation software for Interior designers

paragraphs: A Flask application for interior design businesses to create wood-work quotations, track payments, generate branded PDF quotations and share them with customers on WhatsApp.

This repository is a template: each client gets their own deployment with their own branding (set by environment variables) and their own Postgres database (DATABASEURL). Nothing business-specific is hardcoded.
features: Create quotations with customer details, rooms, and items (length × width → sqft)
Material types: Acrylic, Laminates, Veneer · Work types: Box Work, Frame Work (defined once in app/catalog.py)

Fixed-price items (fittings & accessories such as a Magic Corner or tandem drawers): quantity × unit price, no dimensions. Picked from an admin-managed price list (Admin → Rates), itemised per room in the Full Quotation…
Auto-calculates area and cost per item using admin-configured rates
Discount support — percentage or fixed amount

whatItDoes.text: A Flask application for interior design businesses to create wood-work quotations, track payments, generate branded PDF quotations and share them with customers on WhatsApp.

requirements.text: The "Try the live demo" button goes to that deployment's login page.
One-click entry: /demo signs visitors into the DEMOUSER account (default demo-admin); the login page and landing page link to it.
